name: herdr-commander
description: Inside herdr: commander pane, herdr-backed lifecycle, notifications and cross-agent jobs via herdr-bridge; outside herdr it does nothing

lifecycleReport.title: Report state to herdr
lifecycleReport.description: Report this pane's working/blocked/idle state to herdr (pane report-agent) instead of herdr reading the screen.

notifications.title: Commander notifications
notifications.description: As commander, notify (herdr notification + toast) when another agent becomes blocked or finishes.

listAgentsAugment.title: ListAgents shows herdr agents
listAgentsAugment.description: Append the herdr agents to the ListAgents tool's result.

sendMessageRoute.title: SendMessage reaches herdr agents
sendMessageRoute.description: A SendMessage to a herdr pane id or agent name becomes a tracked herdr job.

pushNotificationMirror.title: Mirror PushNotification to herdr
pushNotificationMirror.description: Also show PushNotification as a herdr notification.

backgroundTools.title: Background commands in herdr panes (P2)
backgroundTools.description: Add herdr_bg_run/read/stop and steer long background shell commands into visible herdr panes.

agentPanes.title: Background agents in herdr panes (P3)
agentPanes.description: Add herdr_agent_spawn and steer long background agent work into visible herdr worker panes.

deliverFlow.title: /deliver through herdr (P4)
deliverFlow.description: When the deliver skill runs inside herdr, add the herdr-pane flavour of the pipeline.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the agent list is refreshed (2-60). One herdr call takes about a second.
